verdict.rationale: Together AI documents an official Docs MCP server that coding agents can connect to, but its documented scope is live lookup of the documentation site. There is no evidence it exposes platform operations such as inference, fine-tuning or endpoint management as MCP tools. Missing for 10: MCP tools for actual Together AI platform actions, setup or transport details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Docs MCP server: Gives your agent live access to this documentation site so it can look up current information without leaving your editor.
Make your AI coding agent Together-AI-aware with ready-made skills for code generation and an MCP server for live docs lookup.
